legal.title: Terms & Disclaimer
legal.body:
About WT Market
WT Market is a third-party War Thunder account marketplace. We operate independently and are not affiliated with any game developer or publisher.

Products Sold
All accounts sold on this platform are third-party accounts with the following conditions:

Accounts are sold without email access.
Credentials provided: username/email + password for game login.
Stock is limited and first-come first-served.
Product descriptions (level, rank, nation, etc.) reflect condition at time of listing — may change with game updates.

Risk Acknowledgement
As a buyer, you understand and agree that:

Third-party accounts carry inherent risks such as access restrictions, deactivation, or recovery by previous owners.
WT Market cannot guarantee long-term account availability after purchase.
Prices may change at any time without prior notice.

Guarantee
We provide a First Login Guarantee: if the provided credentials do not work on first login, we will replace them with a new account at no extra cost. Claim conditions:

Claims must be made within 24 hours of purchase.
Must include screenshot or video proof of failed login.
Guarantee applies to first login only. Does not cover issues after successful login.

Payment & Refunds
Payments are processed through Midtrans (QRIS, bank transfer, e-wallet, cards). By purchasing, you agree that:

No refunds after credentials are successfully delivered to the buyer.
Failed, cancelled, or duplicate payments will be automatically refunded by Midtrans.
All prices are in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).

Privacy
Buyer data (email, WhatsApp, payment information) is used solely for transaction purposes and is not shared with third parties.
